body:
WS1 integration review of 11c5553. The real-device evidence, device picker, granted-processing diagnostics and measurements-only report are useful and should be preserved. The ~62 ms browser estimate versus ~120 ms measured round trip directly explains the user's late-hit report.

Integration changes requested before combining with the WS1 capability:
- An armed Record is now pinned to its original target/deadline in ws1/recording-usability; remove Record from automatic revision-based re-issue when adopting that capability. Re-sending next-beat Record during a stopped count-in can alter its start. The other musical commands retain strict revision checks. See docs/RECORDING-USABILITY.md on that branch.
- MicCheck uses analysedThrough as elapsed time for its peak window. That watermark is intentionally held at the start of an open sung note, so a sustained note prevents peak eviction and stale pitch readings from aging. Use actual processed capture time for diagnostic expiry, separate from verification coverage, and add a sustained-note regression.

The current guidance to keep UI/capture changes owned by WS2 still applies. Please carry these fixes into your calibration/workspace stack and report the resulting head. This review does not establish full calibrated real-performer acceptance.

WS1 integration review of c269457. The 3-second timing countdown, 4 practice/8 measured clicks, Cancel, offset trim and pitch feedback match the updated product direction.

Changes requested before merging:
1. Calibration lifecycle: stopMicrophone(), mic/device disconnection, changing devices and dispose() must cancel/settle a running calibration and stop/disconnect scheduled click nodes. Currently dispose leaves the interval running, and after its AudioContext closes currentTime can stop before plan.end, so the promise never settles. Stop/device change can otherwise measure against a different stream. Add cancellation/lifecycle regressions and preserve the old calibration.
2. The copied MicTestReport still reports measured latency without offsetAdjustMs/effectiveLatencyMs. Include those numeric values (no labels/IDs/audio), with a regression, so post-trim timing reports are reproducible.
3. calibrateNoise still starts measuring immediately and has no cancellation/preparation path. Bring it into the guided calibration flow (visible preparation/countdown and cancellation with prior settings preserved), per PLAN.md, without adding clicks during silence measurement.
4. Please incorporate the PR #7 diagnostic-clock finding and the WS1 armed-Record integration note. Next-beat/live-clear consumer wiring should depend on the reviewed contract merge, not a competing schema.

Please keep these changes in your owned stack; WS1 is not rewriting the UI concurrently.
